questions.question: What was the spark spread at ERCOT's hub average (HB_HUBAVG) on 3 November 2026, at a heat rate of 7.0 MMBtu per MWh against Henry Hub gas, in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: On 3 November 2026 (ERCOT local operating day), the spark spread at HB_HUBAVG was 40.57 USD/MWh (price_board_spreads, derived). The spread is the day-ahead daily mean of 58.98 USD/MWh (price_board_spreads) minus an assumed 7.0 MMBtu/MWh heat rate times Henry Hub gas. The 7.0 heat rate is an assumption of the price board, not a measured plant figure.
